work_title: Under the Wave off Kanagawa (Kanagawa oki nami ura), also known as The Great Wave, from the series Thirty-six Views of Mount Fuji (Fugaku sanjūrokkei)

places.name: Sumida River
places.connection: The area around the Sumida River is believed to be where Hokusai lived and worked.

places.name: The Metropolitan Museum of Art
places.connection: The artwork is part of the museum's collection.

places.connection: Holds a significant impression of 'The Great Wave off Kanagawa'

places.name: The Metropolitan Museum of Art, Asian Art Galleries

places.name: The British Museum, Japanese Galleries

places.name: Mount Fuji Summit
